5461.title: Use pinned Alpine CDN package for native bootstrap (#5414)
5461.body:
[Native/Alpine] Bootstrap from a pinned Alpine CDN package (#5414)

Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4013
Context: https://dev.azure.com/dnceng/internal/_build/results?buildId=3112792
Context: https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_build/results?buildId=1645006
Context: https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_build/results?buildId=1645300

Remove the GitLab generic-package endpoint from Alpine cross-image
bootstrap. October 22 public and internal builds failed before native
compilation while connecting to gitlab.alpinelinux.org:443. One internal
x64 download spent approximately 852 seconds exhausting six attempts.
The same main commit had downloaded and checksum-verified the artifact
successfully on October 20. DNS resolved during investigation, but HTTPS
connections also timed out from the developer machine, including forced
IPv4; this was not confined to 1ES. The exact server or routing fault
remains unconfirmed.

The earlier retry fix in #4013 handled transient GitLab HTTP 500 responses,
but retries cannot repair sustained endpoint unavailability. Use Alpine's
reachable package-distribution CDN instead of its GitLab package registry.
Replace the standalone apk.static 2.12.14 download with the exact
apk-tools-static-2.14.6-r3.apk archive from the existing v3.21/main/x86_64
repository, and pin its SHA-256 before extracting sbin/apk.static.
The x86_64 executable runs on the cross-build host; APK_ARCH continues to
select the target sysroot rather than the bootstrap tool architecture.

Retain curl's HTTP failure detection and five retries, adding a 20-second
connection timeout and 120-second transfer limit per attempt. Preserve
signed fontconfig-dev installation and the explicit Azure Linux CA-bundle
path. Missing artifacts and checksum mismatches stop the build; do not
probe alternate tools or bypass verification. Document updating the exact
package version and archive checksum together. These pins constrain the
bootstrap artifact, not the versions resolved from Alpine's package feeds.

Validation independently verified the embedded executable's Alpine
RSA-SHA256 signature, exercised signed fontconfig-dev installation for
x64, arm, arm64, riscv64 and loongarch64, and rejected both a wrong checksum
and an unavailable package. Public build 1645300 tested head d96d97a4baf
through its PR merge ref and passed the ten Alpine native jobs, covering
those five architectures with and without nodeps. Its x64 image log shows
an actual archive download and successful checksum verification, not a
cached bootstrap layer. The overall run failed in the non-Alpine Linux
x86 job; the Alpine results do not imply a green pipeline.



(cherry picked from commit 48e2083869ab2b154b2058c32682391d1c77e403)

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5351.title: [skia-sync] Incorporate M153 branch cleanup and repaired ancestry
5351.body:
[skia-sync] Incorporate M153 branch cleanup and repaired ancestry (#5351)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/398
Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/399
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/99b6e44ce97cbd7f53f3d6e89c9e8cfa3ccad01d...6bbb2db758f0abaa562e133de2ae4ae7e4b14abf

Advance the release/4.153.x Skia pin to the merged native history while
preserving the reviewed source tree and exact upstream provenance.

~~ Reconcile upstream CQ cleanup ~~

Upstream chrome/m153 commit 37140e1a6a25590812b0103231294f07c2c35977
removes infra/skcq.json because the branch is unsupported by its commit
queue. The fork had already deleted that configuration, so integrating
the cleanup changes ancestry rather than tracked source content.

Record that exact upstream commit in cgmanifest.json. The previous
native pin, reviewed merge, and final native merge share the same tree;
C API exports, dependency pins, and rendering behavior are unchanged.
Independent regeneration matched the four Skia binding files.

~~ Preserve ancestry after the native squash ~~

mono/skia#398 was accidentally squash-merged, retaining the source tree
but losing the reviewed merge and upstream ancestry. mono/skia#399
restored that history through a forward-only, two-parent repair.

Pin externals/skia and its governance commitHash to the actual repair
merge 6bbb2db758f0abaa562e133de2ae4ae7e4b14abf. Verified that the reviewed
head and upstream commit are ancestors and that the complete native
tree matches the reviewed tree.

The repin script requires the reviewed head to be a direct parent,
which this recovery shape does not satisfy. The approved manual repin
instead verified transitive ancestry, two-parent merge structure, and
tree equality, changing only the gitlink and governance commitHash.
The upstream provenance SHA remains unchanged by the repair.

The original sync records successful Linux x64 native-source, managed
build, and console-test validation. Builds and runtime tests were not
rerun for the identical-tree repin; other platforms were not validated
locally.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
